name: SkiaSharp
description: SkiaSharp is a cross-platform 2D graphics API for .NET platforms based on Google's Skia Graphics Library. It provides a comprehensive 2D API that can be used across mobile, server and desktop models to render images.

latest_release.name: Version 4.156.0
latest_release.body:
<!-- SKIASHARP:RELEASE-SUMMARY:START -->
**Stable** — SkiaSharp 4.156.0 adds further path, clip and text rendering fixes after the release candidate.

The stable cut improves clipped convex-path rasterization, reflected hairline caps and glyph-atlas selection, and corrects Graphite alpha-to-RGBx readback. Managed API signatures are unchanged from the release candidate.

📖 [Release notes](https://mono.github.io/SkiaSharp/docs/releases/4.156.0.html) · 📦 [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0) · 🔀 [Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11...v4.156.0)

👥 Contributors: @mattleibow.

🤖 Automation and AI assistance: GitHub Copilot.
